gen-gf-geist-mono-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta spreads out in ribbon-flat strokes, tall and widely tracked. Beneath Geist Mono's chunky, drifting letters, a long page of it would feel unhurried and easy to follow, never crowded.
gen-gf-geist-mono-gf-montserrat-alternat: Chunky monospace letters meet chalkboard lowercase leaning toward the capital line. Geist Mono drifts and spaces itself out up top, and Montserrat Alternates, with its wide-open c, crowds closer below, giving the page two different speeds.
gen-gf-geostar-author: Author reads refined and dignified, with a slight swell on its bowls, and it prefers a quiet corner. Geostar handles the loud work with stems a touch heavier than their links, so a modest body size is a sensible suggestion.
gen-gf-geostar-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, almost at a leisurely walk, with curvy letters and joins as thick as the stems. Geostar does best at a bold, widely tracked announcement, while BhuTuka does best at settling into a literary, authoritative voice.
gen-gf-geostar-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab looks stretched out and bookish, its joins never thinning. Its size can go up a notch to let those open counters breathe, while Geostar, mildly tapered like flattened wire, stays put.
gen-gf-geostar-gf-kiwi-maru: Fuller stems, slimmer links, wide gaps. Geostar's soft cadence of thick and thin leads, and Kiwi Maru follows with ring-round o shapes and stray terminals, so the pair's strongest quality is its unhurried, editorial spacing.
gen-gf-geostar-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Geostar leads with stems barely thicker than its links and generous tracking. Padyakke Expanded One follows in a marker-like line, wide-mouthed c shapes spread out like knots on a slack rope, making a long page feel slow and literary.
gen-gf-geostar-fill-author: Author reads refined and dignified, its bowls swelling just slightly. Author keeps a gentle hand against Geostar Fill's expressive, widely tracked display letters, and that restraint is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-geostar-fill-gf-kiwi-maru: Geostar Fill's bowls swell only slightly at their widest, with tracking that never tightens. And Kiwi Maru, a text serif with ring-round o shapes and no calligraphic modulation, gives the pair an editorial, traditional steadiness.
gen-gf-geostar-fill-gf-padyakke-expanded: Expressive and distinctive, Geostar Fill carries a moderate thick-thin ratio, while Padyakke Expanded One draws a true monoline. Together the two make a lively, loose-limbed page.
